findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, Second Reading
findings.note: Voted Aye (final tally 66 Aye, 47 No). The bill, as ratified (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf), requires a voter registration application to affirmatively state the applicant is a United States citizen before the county board processes it, and has the State Board of Elections create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. It does not change in-person photo ID rules.

findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, M11 Concur
findings.note: Voted Aye (62 Aye, 47 No) on the House concurring vote on the Senate changes to HB 958, which the member vote page lists as passing. The bill adds a citizenship statement on registration applications and a removal process for flagged non-citizen registrations.
